items.work: Quatuor pour la fin du temps
items.performers: Tashi: Ida Kavafian, violin; Richard Stoltzman, clarinet; Fred Sherry, cello; Peter Serkin, piano
items.label: RCA Red Seal / Sony Music
items.note: Eight movements for clarinet, violin, cello and piano grew out of Messiaen’s captivity in 1940–41. Tashi plays the dances with close unanimity and gives the cello’s slow ‘Louange’ a continuous line.

items.label: Hyperion
items.note: Messiaen’s twenty piano meditations on the infant Christ begin with the recurring ‘Theme of God’. Osborne’s touch varies across the two hours, from the quiet contemplations to the dance rhythms of ‘Regard de l’Esprit de joie’.

items.performers: Jean-Yves Thibaudet, piano; Takashi Harada, ondes Martenot; Royal Concertgebouw Orchestra; Riccardo Chailly, conductor
items.label: Decca
items.note: A solo piano and the electronic ondes Martenot play with a very large orchestra through ten movements of love music. Chailly’s recording makes the crowded instrumental lines unusually clear, with Thibaudet in the virtuoso piano part.
